subject: LuminaHealth private offer: consolidate commitments & DocuSign routing
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@luminahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@luminahealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating our commitments across BU accounts + DocuSign routing

Hi Priyom —

Quick one: Lumina wants to consolidate three existing Marketplace private offers (Clinical, Ops, and Analytics) into a single committed PO to simplify finance and to get the best price tier. We need:
- an updated private-offer summary with per-BU capacity mapping,
- a consolidated PO template we can circulate to procurement, and
- a recommended signer mapping for DocuSign (who signs on behalf of Lumina vs Redwood).

We'd like to close this by the end of next week. Can Redwood own the DocuSign flow and send a single envelope, or do we need separate envelopes per BU? Also—any impact on accepted start date for committed capacity if we merge?

Thanks,
Sonia
Sonia Patel
Head of Cloud Procurement, LuminaHealth

----
Attachment: Lumina_current_commitments.csv (attachment referenced)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating our commitments across BU accounts + DocuSign routing

Sonia — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely do a single consolidated private offer and manage the DocuSign envelope from our side. High-level plan:

1) Redwood prepares a single Private Offer Summary that maps current BU commitments into one consolidated commitment and shows equivalent unit allocations per BU (attachment: Private_Offer_Summary_Lumina.xlsx).
2) We'll provide a consolidated PO template and a suggested signature map (who signs for Lumina vs Redwood).
3) DocuSign: one envelope with role-based signing (Lumina lead + Lumina legal + Redwood exec). If Lumina prefers separate signers per BU, we can split into composite signing tabs but still send one envelope.
4) Start date: merging commitments does not change the original acceptance window, but we'll flag in the DocuSign envelope an explicit effective start date to avoid confusion.

I've looped in Kimberly and Marissa for pricing/ops confirmation and Ben for billing/invoice tranching. Expect updated attachments and the envelope link by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Priyom Das
Head of Cloud Marketplace, Redwood Inference

----
Attachments: Private_Offer_Summary_Lumina.xlsx, Lumina_PO_Template_v3.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating our commitments across BU accounts + DocuSign routing

Priyom — see my quick pricing/ops notes inline:

- Pricing tier: combining the three commitments gets Lumina into the next tier (10% incremental discount) once the consolidated commit crosses 1.2M platform units/yr. We'll show both current blended pricing and the post-consolidation tier in the summary.
- Capacity mapping: Ops has seasonal surges. Recommend we keep a small burst buffer (10% of Ops allocation) in the consolidated commit and a soft cap we can monitor.
- SKU mapping: I added SKU IDs in the spreadsheet and a recommended quantization profile.

Marissa — can you confirm we can commit to the effective start date of 2028-04-01 if Lumina signs by 2028-03-31?

-Kimberly

----
Attachment: pricing_notes_Lumina.md

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating our commitments across BU accounts + DocuSign routing

Confirming we can do 2028-04-01 effective start if signature is returned by 2028-03-31 EOD. Ops: we'll need a short onboarding window (7 business days) to spin up reserved capacity topology for the consolidated offer, and we'll coordinate a canary capacity launch for Ops BU.

Ben — I'll need the invoice tranche plan for the consolidated PO. Lumina asked about quarterly invoicing split across BUs (they prefer separate GL codes) — is that doable?

-Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating our commitments across BU accounts + DocuSign routing

We can do quarterly invoices split by BU GL codes. Two options:
A) One consolidated PO / one invoice per quarter with internal line-items per BU (single invoice file, Lumina extracts allocations).
B) One consolidated PO / separate invoices per BU each quarter (three invoice files, separate GLs).

Option A is operationally simpler on our side; Option B matches Lumina's current finance process better. Recommend offering both and letting Lumina choose. I'll attach a sample invoice layout and the signature_map.csv for DocuSign roles.

-Ben
----
Attachments: sample_invoice_consolidated_q1.pdf, signature_map.csv
